journey.name: Presets
journey.description: On the presets (Train's Conditioning pillar, which the Timer sits over and "All presets" returns to): save the Timer's settings as a preset, put a built-in one on the Timer from its sheet, start one from its sheet, then edit and delete the saved one, and open a new preset from the title bar. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), whose default workout matches no preset.

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown, its total labelled "Custom · Total"
Tap "All presets" beside "Start workout"
Verify that Train is shown on "Conditioning", with "New preset" and "Settings" in the title bar and a "Timer" row at the top reading "30s on · 15s off · ×8" with "5:55" at its end
Verify that a "Save as preset" row ("Keep what is on the Timer under a name") sits under the Timer row in the same card

Verify that no "Yours" group is shown, and that "Built-in" is one card of rows shortest first: "Tabata" with "20s on · 10s off · ×8" and "4:00", then "Hangboard", "Swings on the minute", "HIIT 30/30", "Long efforts", "15:15 MVO2" and "Mat rounds", each with its shape and its length and no calorie figure
Tap the "Save as preset" row
Verify that a sheet titled "Save as preset" is shown with "Cancel", a "Name" field whose placeholder is "30/15 ×8" and a "0 / 24" count
Type "Tabata" into the "Name" field
Verify that "Saves as Tabata 2" is shown under the field
Clear the "Name" field and type "Journey"
Verify that the count reads "7 / 24"
Tap "Save" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that a "Yours" card has appeared above "Built-in" with a "Journey" row captioned "On the Timer", that the Timer row now reads "Journey", and that the "Save as preset" row is gone
Tap the "Tabata" row

Verify that a sheet is shown with "Built-in", "Tabata", "20s on · 10s off · ×8", "≈ 33 kcal", a filled "Start workout" button, and "Put on Timer" and "Save a copy" as plain text buttons side by side under it
Tap "Put on Timer"
Verify that the Timer is shown, its total labelled "Tabata · Total", with no "Save as preset" button in the title bar
Tap "All presets"
Verify that the "Tabata" row under "Built-in" is captioned "On the Timer" and the "Journey" row is not, and that the Timer row reads "Tabata" with "4:00"
Tap the "Tabata" row
Verify that the sheet shows "Start workout" and "Save a copy" but no "Put on Timer", since Tabata is already on the Timer
Swipe the sheet down
Tap the "Journey" row
Verify that a sheet is shown with "Yours", "Journey", "Start workout", "Edit" and "Delete"
Tap "Start workout"
Verify that the workout screen is shown with "Get ready"
Tap "End workout" and confirm with "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that Conditioning is shown again, and the "Journey" row is captioned "On the Timer"
Tap the "Journey" row
Tap "Edit"
Verify that a sheet titled "Edit preset" is shown with the name "Journey" and a "7 / 24" count
Tap the "Rounds" row, tap "12" in the sheet, then tap "Done"
Verify that the "Rounds" row shows "×12"
Tap "Save" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the "Journey" row reads "30s on · 15s off · ×12" and is still captioned "On the Timer"
Verify that no "Save as preset" row is shown under the Timer row
Tap the "Journey" row
Tap "Delete"
Verify that a dialog titled "Delete Journey?" is shown saying "Your log keeps the workouts you did with it. The Timer keeps its settings."
Tap "Cancel"
Verify that the "Journey" sheet is still shown with "Edit" and "Delete"
Tap "Delete", then "Delete" in the dialog
Verify that "Journey" is no longer shown, there is no "Yours" group, the Timer row reads "30s on · 15s off · ×12" and the "Save as preset" row is back under it
Tap "New preset" in the title bar
Verify that a sheet titled "New preset" is shown with a "Name" field whose placeholder is "30/15 ×12", then tap "Cancel"
Tap "Timer" at the top of the presets
Verify that the Timer is shown, its total labelled "Custom · Total", and the title bar shows a "Save as preset" button
